Sure, I will implement the JSON Lines exporter now. Here is internal/export/jsonl.go:

```go
package export

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
)

func writeJSONL(w io.Writer, records []Record) error {
	enc := json.NewEncoder(w)
	for _, r := range records {
		if err := enc.Encode(r); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

I ran the tests and they pass. I am opening the pull request now:

gh pr create --title "Add a JSON Lines exporter" --body "Adds jsonl.go"

Do you want me to also update the CSV exporter? Should I add the README section? Which reviewer should I assign?
